Title: FR-23 Include citation pills in responses
Description:
Every factual response shall include at least one citation rendered as a clickable citation pill displaying document title, proclamation number, and article number. Citations shall be extracted from metadata of the retrieved chunks that contributed to the response.

Verification: Automated test parsing sample responses and asserting all contain at least one citation with the required metadata fields.
Creator: baslielselamu2018@gmail.com

Title: FR-16 Generate category-aware query embeddings
Description:
The system shall convert the user query into a 1024-dimensional embedding using the multilingual-e5-large model. If the user's profile is set to a specific taxpayer category, the query embedding shall be generated with a category-specific prefix prompt to bias retrieval toward relevant regulations.

Verification: Unit test asserting query embeddings are generated in under 200 ms on target hardware.
Creator: baslielselamu2018@gmail.com

Title: FR-14 Detect query language automatically
Description:
Upon receiving a user query, the system shall automatically detect the language of the input using a FastText-based language identifier. Supported languages are Amharic and English. For code-switched inputs, the system shall select the dominant language for processing and log the detection as 'mixed'.

Verification: Unit test asserting correct language detection for mono-lingual and mixed-language fixture queries.
Creator: baslielselamu2018@gmail.com

Title: FR-12 Re-index documents atomically
Description:
When a document is re-indexed due to admin override or content update, the system shall atomically delete all existing chunks and embeddings associated with that document_id before inserting the new chunks, preventing duplicate vectors.

Verification: Integration test re-indexing a document and asserting the chunk count equals the new chunk count rather than doubling.
Creator: baslielselamu2018@gmail.com

Title: FR-11 Maintain BM25 full-text index
Description:
The system shall maintain a BM25 full-text search index over chunk text using PostgreSQL built-in full-text search infrastructure to enable hybrid retrieval.

Verification: Integration test asserting the BM25 index returns non-empty results for a known keyword query.
Creator: baslielselamu2018@gmail.com

Title: FR-10 Store multilingual-e5-large embeddings
Description:
The system shall generate 1024-dimensional vector embeddings for each chunk using the multilingual-e5-large model. Embeddings shall be stored in PostgreSQL pgvector using cosine distance.

Verification: Integration test asserting embedding dimension is 1024 for sample chunks.
Creator: baslielselamu2018@gmail.com

Title: FR-09 Store chunk metadata fields
Description:
Each chunk shall be stored with metadata including document_id, chunk_id, source_url, document_title, proclamation_number if applicable, article_number if applicable, effective_date, language, and created_at timestamp.

Verification: Database schema validation asserting all metadata columns are non-null for a representative set of indexed chunks.
Creator: baslielselamu2018@gmail.com

Title: FR-08 Chunk documents with overlap
Description:
The system shall segment extracted document text into chunks of 512–1024 tokens using a sentence-boundary-aware sliding window with a 10% token overlap between consecutive chunks. The overlap preserves semantic continuity across chunk boundaries.

Verification: Unit test asserting no chunk exceeds 1024 tokens and each consecutive chunk pair shares at least 50 tokens.
Creator: baslielselamu2018@gmail.com

Title: FR-04 Preserve Amharic Unicode end-to-end
Description:
The system shall correctly extract and preserve Amharic Unicode (Ethiopic script, Unicode block U+1200–U+137F) from all document types. Characters must survive the full pipeline from extraction through chunking to response display without corruption.

Verification: Round-trip Unicode integrity test using a fixture document containing known Amharic strings.
Creator: baslielselamu2018@gmail.com

Title: FR-02 Prevent redundant document downloads
Description:
The scraper shall compute a SHA-256 hash of each discovered document URL and file size. A document shall be downloaded only if its hash is not present in the Document Registry table, preventing redundant re-downloads.

Verification: Integration test running the scraper twice in succession and asserting the second run downloads zero new files.
Creator: baslielselamu2018@gmail.com

Title: FR-03 Support HTML, PDF, and OCR extraction
Description:
The system shall support three document retrieval modes: HTML page text extraction, PDF text extraction via PyMuPDF, and OCR-based extraction via Tesseract as fallback for image-only PDFs. The extraction mode shall be selected automatically based on the PDF's text-layer presence.

Verification: Unit tests per extraction mode with representative fixture documents.
Creator: baslielselamu2018@gmail.com

Title: FR-01 Daily scheduled scraping job
Description:
The system shall execute a scheduled scraping job daily at 00:00 EAT via a Cron scheduler. The job shall scan the MoR website's Proclamations, Directives, and Announcements pages for new or updated documents.

Verification: Automated test to verify cron execution log contains a success entry at 00:00 ±5 min.
Creator: baslielselamu2018@gmail.com

Title: FR-39 Compute monthly evaluation metrics
Description:
The system shall compute Exact Match, F1 Score, and BERTScore monthly using the anonymized query log against a curated gold-standard test set of 100 labelled queries. Results shall be displayed in the Admin Dashboard analytics section.

Verification: Integration test running the evaluation pipeline on a seeded test set and asserting all three metrics are computed and stored.
Creator: baslielselamu2018@gmail.com

Title: FR-36 Show real-time health metrics
Description:
The Admin Dashboard shall display real-time system health metrics including server CPU and RAM utilization, rolling 5-minute LLM API response latency, vector database query latency, and Telegram bot webhook status, refreshed every 30 seconds.

Verification: Integration test asserting the metrics endpoint returns all required fields with recent timestamps.
Creator: baslielselamu2018@gmail.com

Title: FR-35 Detect duplicate uploads before overwrite
Description:
When upload processing detects that a document's content hash already exists in the vector database, the system shall alert the admin that identical content has already been indexed and offer overwrite or cancel. An overwrite shall atomically delete all chunks associated with the existing document_id before re-indexing.

Verification: Integration test uploading the same document twice and asserting a duplicate detection prompt appears on the second upload.
Creator: baslielselamu2018@gmail.com

Title: FR-31 Support saved chats and citations
Description:
Registered users shall be able to view past conversation sessions with date and time labels, export a conversation transcript as PDF or plain text, save individual citations to a bookmarks list, and delete individual sessions or all history.

Verification: UI tests for each sub-requirement using a seeded test user account.
Creator: baslielselamu2018@gmail.com

Title: FR-24 Refuse abusive or off-topic queries
Description:
The system shall detect and refuse to process queries containing profane, abusive, or off-topic content using a lightweight content classifier. The refusal message shall be polite and invite the user to resubmit a tax-related query.

Verification: Test submitting flagged query fixtures and asserting all are refused with the correct message.
Creator: baslielselamu2018@gmail.com

Title: FR-13 Show indexing progress stages
Description:
The system shall display a real-time progress indicator in the Admin Dashboard during indexing, showing the current pipeline stage: Parsing, Chunking, Embedding, and Indexing. The document status shall update to 'Active/Searchable' only upon successful completion of all stages.

Verification: UI test monitoring the Admin Dashboard during upload and asserting all four stages are displayed sequentially.
Creator: baslielselamu2018@gmail.com

Title: FR-07 Allow ad-hoc scraping from admin UI
Description:
The admin shall be able to manually trigger an ad-hoc scraping run from the Knowledge Base Manager at any time, bypassing the scheduled run.

Verification: UI test clicking 'Sync / Re-index' and verifying the scraper execution log shows a triggered run.
Creator: baslielselamu2018@gmail.com

Title: FR-06 Flag low-confidence OCR for manual review
Description:
When the scraper encounters a scanned PDF for which OCR confidence is below 70%, the document shall be flagged as 'Requires Manual Review' in the Admin Dashboard and excluded from indexing. The admin shall be able to provide a corrected text file to complete the ingestion.

Verification: Test ingesting a deliberately low-quality scanned PDF and asserting the flag appears in the Admin Dashboard.
Creator: baslielselamu2018@gmail.com
